items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 May 2026 4:18am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 18 May 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind later.


##Synopsis##

Shallow low near northern Scotland. Slow-moving low in Mid-Atlantic with associated weather fronts moving into the British Isles later today and tonight.


##Wind##

West or southwest backing south, 2 to 4. Backing southeast 4 or 5 during this evening. Increasing 5 or 6, occasionally 7, overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mostly moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Soon becoming mostly fair this morning. Rain spreading from the southwest this evening and tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in the showers or rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 5 or 6, occasionally 7, soon veering south 5 or 6 tomorrow morning, then slowly veering southwest thereafter. Decreasing 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Mostly moderate, possibly rough in a few places at times.


##Weather##

Rain, clearing to scattered showers tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor at first.
